title: MZ [SOLVED]Visustella - Run Common Event in Menu

posts.author: Agentpdx
posts.body:
Using Visustella's Items and Equips Core, I'm creating a system where certain Armors can dynamically affect the number of Accessory (a different type of Armor) slots you have. Unfortunately, Plugin Commands are the only way to do so with this particular plugin, and while it technically works with standard Common Event functionality, it comes with an obnoxious QOL issue. The player has to equip an Armor, exit the Equip Menu, and then reenter the menu to see the number of equip slots actually change.
I've heard there are ways to run Common Events without exiting the Menu Scene in RPG Maker MV, and I've even found such a plugin for RGSS3, but I haven't found anything I can actually use. If someone could point me in the right direction, or even make something on the fly, that would be much appreciated.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Did that waynee equipeval stuff work in RPG Maker MZ?
If yes, try running the plugin commands in script form with that. You can google here how to run them like that (it's shown in the Ultimate New User Manual also, I think).
EDIT: Check post 8 for better info.

posts.author: Agentpdx
posts.body: As useful as that plugin would be under most circumstances, I don't think it'll work here. I'd have to find the actual code that the Plugin Command is based off of, which normally wouldn't be too hard, but most of Visustella's code is heavily obfuscated. If there is a way to run a Plugin Command in Javascript, or a way to de-obfuscate the code with relative ease, then it'd work out.
